notes.1.205: The long compound is taken as an epithet-name; ḏꜣ-jtr is 'cross the river', wp,t 'brow' or 'top of the head'.

nodes.text: For it is Hesat, who suckled Ra, Mehet-weret, as She-who-carried-Ra-across-the-river-on-her-brow-as-a-child.
